# Gradle wrapper

The wrapper JAR (`gradle-wrapper.jar`) and shell scripts (`gradlew`, `gradlew.bat`)
are generated by Gradle itself — they are not hand-authored.

**One-time setup** (requires Gradle 8.10+ installed on your machine or PATH):

```bash
cd apps/backend
gradle wrapper --gradle-version=8.10.2
```

This creates:

- `apps/backend/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar`
- `apps/backend/gradlew`
- `apps/backend/gradlew.bat`

After that, every developer/CI can build without any system Gradle:

```bash
./gradlew bootRun     # Unix
gradlew.bat bootRun   # Windows
```

The npm wrapper (`node scripts/gradle.js …`) will automatically prefer
the wrapper once it exists, and falls back to system `gradle` until then.

Commit the generated `gradle-wrapper.jar`, `gradlew`, and `gradlew.bat` to the repo.
